messages:
Alex P: seeing a steady uptick in p95 for /v1/generate since 09:30 UTC, customer report + internal alerts. p99 spiking intermittently as well.
Maya R: seen it too, looks correlated with longer prompts from partner-X shard.
Samir K: can you paste the p95/p99 numbers?
Alex P: p95 -> 280ms -> 480ms over last 30m, p99 -> 1.2s -> 2.8s. Request rate is stable.
Jordan (oncall): are we hitting CPU or GPU scheduling limits? graphs?
Maya R: attach from console: link to dashboard (tokenized) - top queue depth on pool-dedicated-gpu-3, small increase in KV cache miss ratio.
SRE-Bot: alert: p99_latency > 2s for service:inference-api (rule: latency-p99-prod)
Samir K: quick triage plan: 1) enable circuit breaker for heavy requests 2) fallback routing to smaller model variant 3) temporary per-key rate limit for partner-X 4) investigate KV cache invalidations + prefix caching.
Alex P: agree. Jordan can you run circuit-breaker toggle for route /v1/generate -> set failureThreshold=0.2, window=60s?
Jordan (oncall): running: rbctl routes patch /v1/generate --cb-failure 0.2 --cb-window 60s  --dry=false  (returns: success) :white_check_mark:
Maya R: while CB is rolling, I'll open fallback: route partner-X to gpt-medium-quant (compatible). Add header-based routing for partner-X API key.
Samir K: command I used: rbctl routing add --match "api_key:partner-x" --target gpt-medium-quant --priority 10. Applied and propagated to edge in ~12s.
Alex P: also pushed short-term rate limit for partner-X to 50r/min: rbctl quotas set --key partner-x --limit 50rpm.
SRE-Bot: config-change recorded: circuit_breaker, routing, quotas by Jordan, Samir, Maya.
Jordan (oncall): monitor: p95 dropped from 480ms -> 320ms within 2 minutes; p99 still jittery ~1.6s. We might need to flush/rehydrate KV caches for that pool.
Maya R: rehydrate plan: warm prefixes from recent traffic via replay job: jobs/replay warm --model gpt-large --pool pool-dedicated-gpu-3 --top 1000. Kicking it now.
Samir K: if KV misses are causing p99 tail, consider prefilling top-utterances and increasing local kv_cache_size to 1.5x for that pool. Quick patch: rbctl pool patch pool-dedicated-gpu-3 --kv-cache-mb 1536.
Alex P: applied, let's watch error budget. Reminder: SLOs: p95 < 350ms, p99 < 1.8s for hosted-tier; current p95=310ms, p99=1.5-1.6s after mitigations.
Jordan (oncall): rolling back circuit breaker now? or keep for 15m to ensure stability?
Maya R: keep for 15m then step down to failureThreshold=0.35. Also add alert escalation if p99 > 1.8s for 10m to paging.
Samir K: added guardrail: if p95 > 400ms -> auto-route 20% of traffic to cheap-geo (eu-west-2) fallback model to reduce tail. Config: rbctl fallback create --trigger p95>400ms:10m --route 20%:eu-west-2:gpt-medium.
Alex P: doc the runbook steps and customer comms: short note to CS about mitigations and expected improvement window (10-30m).
Jordan (oncall): will update incident thread and close if stable for 30m.
Maya R: quick repro steps for follow-up: 1) reproduce with partner-X long prompt (paste sample) 2) hit /v1/generate at 120rps for 2 mins 3) verify kv_cache miss rate spikes in metrics.
Samir K: postmortem action items: improve prefix cache telemetry, auto-warm for top 1% requests, tighten SLO alert thresholds, document fallback routing templates.
Alex P: thanks team. closing in 20m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
